The planet [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] had a '''constable''' at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. When Wayland was [[Battle of Wayland (Mandalorian Wars)|attacked]] by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], the constable packed up and attempted to leave with his family. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Krav Noblis]] tried to turn in a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] while the constable was making his exit, and when Noblis asked for a voucher from the nearby [[Lhosan Industries]] building in lieu of payment, the constable replied that the building was full of Mandalorian [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk droids]].
